scene: Launch Echolot with no workspace window (no -open). Alpenglow.echolot and Examples.echolot should be in Recent workspaces (open each once, then close their windows). The welcome window shows New Workspace…, Open Workspace…, Open Examples and the recent list.

Launch with -open /tmp/Alpenglow.echolot -page home -showWhatsNew YES. Click the What's New button (sparkles, first of the buttons at the top right of the page header) so its popover opens with the latest release's notes.
frame: the top right of the window: the page header's buttons and the open popover

scene: Alpenglow, no environment, side-by-side layout. Make (or use) a request named List products at the top level with the address https://demo.echolot.dev/v1/products?category=tents&per_page=5 (method GET, no headers). Send it. Request side on the Params tab (category and per_page listed); response side on Body with View: JSON. Pointer away from the status line.

Alpenglow, no environment, side-by-side layout, Requests module (⌘1). Folders Auth and Catalog expanded in the sidebar. Open Auth › Sign in, then Catalog › List products so both are tabs; List products active and sent, response on Body › JSON Tree with the first item expanded. Echo on (Settings › General › Echo › Show Echo's status screen in the page header) so it shows in the header.
Alpenglow, no environment, on Catalog › List products (sent once, so history has responses). Press ⌘K and type: prod
frame: the command palette and the part of the window around it

scene: Make the collection first: echolot export /tmp/shots-export -w /tmp/Alpenglow.echolot --format postman (it writes Alpenglow.postman_collection.json and the environments into that folder). Open a fresh copy of Alpenglow, select nothing (top level), File › Import… (⇧⌘I) and choose /tmp/shots-export/Alpenglow.postman_collection.json. The import report opens: Imported 22 requests, 7 folders, a note on the 19 imported scripts, and the line on secret values saved to the Keychain.

Alpenglow, environment Production (protected) chosen in the page header's Environment menu. Open Catalog › List products; the Send button reads Send to Production…. Click it so the question opens: Send to Production?, with Cancel as the default button and the Don't ask again until I switch environments checkbox.
frame: the alert sheet and the request header above it

scene: Alpenglow, no environment. New request (⌘N) named Local server with the address http://localhost:9/health; send it (nothing listens on port 9). The response pane shows No echo, Connection refused: nothing is listening on localhost:9. Is the server running on that port?, and Try Again.

Alpenglow, no environment, launched with -page home -greetingName Heidi. Send a spread of requests first (Run Folder on Catalog and Orders, several times, so Sonar has pings in every zone and a failure or two: the demo API's /echo/status/500). Sonar on 7 d.
As get-started-home. Rest the pointer on a ping so its callout shows (time, status, method and name, Click to open its response). tools/scenes.ts has the scene.
frame: the Sonar card: header with key and period, the five figures, the chart with its callout, the zone bar

scene: Alpenglow, no environment. Launch with -showTour YES, click Show Me Around and Next until Step 4 of 8 (Environments).
